import re

def parse_pdf(path):
    """Return (raw bytes, {objnum: offset}) for a classic-xref PDF."""
    data = open(path, "rb").read()
    m = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)
    if not m:
        raise ValueError(f"no startxref in {path}")
    xref_off = int(m.group(1))
    if data[xref_off:xref_off+4] != b"xref":
        raise ValueError(f"no classic xref table at {xref_off} in {path}")
    pos = xref_off + 4
    offsets = {}
    while True:
        # skip blank lines
        while data[pos:pos+1] in (b"\r", b"\n", b" ", b"\t"):
            pos += 1
        line_end = data.index(b"\n", pos)
        line = data[pos:line_end].strip()
        pos = line_end + 1
        if not re.match(rb"^\d+ \d+$", line):
            break
        start, count = map(int, line.split())
        for i in range(count):
            entry = data[pos:pos+20]
            pos += 20
            typ = entry[17:18]
            if typ == b"n":
                offsets[start + i] = int(entry[:10])
    return data, offsets

def extract_object(data, offsets, num):
    """Return raw bytes of object num (from its offset up to endobj)."""
    start = offsets[num]
    nxt = min((o for n, o in offsets.items() if n != num and o > start), default=None)
    if nxt is not None:
        chunk = data[start:nxt]
    else:
        e = data.find(b"endobj", start)
        chunk = data[start:e + len(b"endobj")]
    # trim trailing whitespace after endobj
    end = chunk.rfind(b"endobj")
    return chunk[:end + len(b"endobj")]

def replace_refs(body, shift):
    """Shift indirect references 'N G R' -> 'N+shift G R' in non-stream bodies."""
    if b"endstream" in body:
        return body
    def rep(m):
        num = int(m.group(1))
        return f"{num + shift} {m.group(2).decode()} R".encode()
    return re.sub(rb"(?<![0-9/])(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+R(?![0-9])", rep, body)

def replace_header(body, new_num):
    m = re.match(rb"(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+obj", body)
    old_header = m.group(0)
    new_header = f"{new_num} {m.group(2).decode()} obj".encode()
    return body.replace(old_header, new_header, 1)

def add_parent(body, parent_num):
    """Insert /Parent <num> 0 R into a Pages dict (before its closing >>)."""
    idx = body.rfind(b">>")
    if idx == -1:
        raise ValueError("no dict close found")
    return body[:idx] + f"/Parent {parent_num} 0 R ".encode() + body[idx:]

d2, o2 = parse_pdf("report_part2.pdf")

n2 = max(o2)

# file1 objects keep their numbers
for num in sorted(o1):
    if num == 0:
        continue
    body = extract_object(d1, o1, num)
    out_objects[num] = body

# file2 objects shifted
for num in sorted(o2):
    if num == 0:
        continue
    body = extract_object(d2, o2, num)
    body = replace_header(body, num + shift)
    body = replace_refs(body, shift)
    out_objects[num + shift] = body

# locate the two Pages objects (7 in each) to wire the new root
pages1 = 7
pages2 = 7 + shift
# add /Parent to each Pages object (they are not roots anymore)
out_objects[pages1] = add_parent(out_objects[pages1], 0)  # placeholder, fixed below
out_objects[pages2] = add_parent(out_objects[pages2], 0)

root_pages_num = n1 + n2 + 1
catalog_num = n1 + n2 + 2
size = n1 + n2 + 3

out_objects[pages1] = add_parent(extract_object(d1, o1, 7), root_pages_num)
out_objects[pages2] = add_parent(extract_object(d2, o2, 7), root_pages_num)
out_objects[pages2] = replace_header(out_objects[pages2], pages2)
out_objects[pages2] = replace_refs(out_objects[pages2], shift)

root_pages = f"<< /Count 2 /Kids [ {pages1} 0 R {pages2} 0 R ] /Type /Pages >>".encode()
out_objects[root_pages_num] = root_pages

catalog = f"<< /PageMode /UseNone /Pages {root_pages_num} 0 R /Type /Catalog >>".encode()
out_objects[catalog_num] = catalog

# ---- assemble file ----
header = b"%PDF-1.3\n%\x93\x8c\x8b\x9e ReportLab Generated PDF document (opensource)\n"
out = bytearray(header)
offsets_out = {}
for num in sorted(out_objects):
    offsets_out[num] = len(out)
    out += out_objects[num]
    if not out.endswith(b"endobj"):
        out += b"\n"
    out += b"\n"

xref_off = len(out)
out += b"xref\n"
out += f"0 {size}\n".encode()
out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
for num in range(1, size):
    if num in offsets_out:
        out += f"{offsets_out[num]:010d} 00000 n \n".encode()
    else:
        out += b"0000000000 00000 n \n"
out += b"trailer\n<<\n"
out += f"/Info 6 0 R\n/Root {catalog_num} 0 R\n/Size {size}\n".encode()
out += b">>\nstartxref\n"
out += str(xref_off).encode() + b"\n%%EOF\n"

with open("combined_report.pdf", "wb") as f:
    f.write(bytes(out))
print(f"wrote combined_report.pdf ({len(out)} bytes, {size-1} objects)")

# ---- self-validation: re-parse the merged file ----
data, offs = parse_pdf("combined_report.pdf")
print("re-parsed objects:", sorted(offs))
assert set(offs) == set(range(1, size)), "xref mismatch"
for num in sorted(offs):
    assert data[offs[num]:offs[num]+3] != b"end", f"bad offset for {num}"
print("validation OK")

import re

def parse_pdf(path):
    """Return (raw bytes, {objnum: offset}) for a classic-xref PDF."""
    data = open(path, "rb").read()
    m = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)
    if not m:
        raise ValueError(f"no startxref in {path}")
    xref_off = int(m.group(1))
    if data[xref_off:xref_off+4] != b"xref":
        raise ValueError(f"no classic xref table at {xref_off} in {path}")
    pos = xref_off + 4
    offsets = {}
    while True:
        # skip blank lines / whitespace
        while data[pos:pos+1] in (b"\r", b"\n", b" ", b"\t"):
            pos += 1
        line_end = data.index(b"\n", pos)
        line = data[pos:line_end].strip()
        pos = line_end + 1
        if not re.match(rb"^\d+ \d+$", line):
            break
        start, count = map(int, line.split())
        for i in range(count):
            entry = data[pos:pos+20]
            pos += 20
            typ = entry[17:18]
            if typ == b"n":
                offsets[start + i] = int(entry[:10])
    return data, offsets

def extract_object(data, offsets, num):
    """Return raw bytes of object num (from its offset up to endobj)."""
    start = offsets[num]
    nxt = min((o for n, o in offsets.items() if n != num and o > start), default=None)
    if nxt is not None:
        chunk = data[start:nxt]
    else:
        e = data.find(b"endobj", start)
        chunk = data[start:e + len(b"endobj")]
    end = chunk.rfind(b"endobj")
    return chunk[:end + len(b"endobj")]

def replace_refs(body, shift):
    """Shift indirect references 'N G R' -> 'N+shift G R' in non-stream bodies."""
    if b"endstream" in body:
        return body
    def rep(m):
        num = int(m.group(1))
        return f"{num + shift} {m.group(2).decode()} R".encode()
    return re.sub(rb"(?<![0-9/])(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+R(?![0-9])", rep, body)

def replace_header(body, new_num):
    m = re.match(rb"(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+obj", body)
    old_header = m.group(0)
    new_header = f"{new_num} {m.group(2).decode()} obj".encode()
    return body.replace(old_header, new_header, 1)

def add_parent(body, parent_num):
    """Insert /Parent <num> 0 R into a Pages dict (before its closing >>)."""
    idx = body.rfind(b">>")
    if idx == -1:
        raise ValueError("no dict close found")
    return body[:idx] + f"/Parent {parent_num} 0 R ".encode() + body[idx:]
